module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input enable,
  input S,
  input A,
  input B,
  input C,
  output reg Z
);

always @(posedge clk) begin
  if (enable)
    Z <= S ? (A | B) : (B & C);
end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input [3:0] a,
  input [3:0] b,
  input [3:0] c,
  input [3:0] d,
  input [3:0] e,
  output reg [3:0] q
);
  always @(*) begin
    q = 4'b0000;
  end
endmodule

module TopModule (
  input a,

  input c,
  input d,
  output reg out
);
  always @(*) begin
    out = 1'b0;
  end
endmodule

module TopModule (

module adder_8bit(
    input [7:0] a, b, 
    input cin, 
    output [7:0] sum, 
    output cout);

assign {cout, sum} = a + b + cin;

endmodule
